scope: All repeat-LAE observations with same-source IDs or isolated positional repeats and good matched DESI VI z=1.88-3.52 considered in this release. At most 120 unique objects per population receive direct Tractor checks, prioritized in thirds by LAN optical priority, lower line flux and fixed-seed sampling. Up to 12 with missing/zero imaging bound per population get paired-aperture attempts before final external vetting. No source is promoted by a missing flux.
